rows.note: Use 入迷 as the default for being completely absorbed or fascinated by something.

example.english: This mystery novel can engross me so much that I forget to check my phone.
example.traditional: 呢本推理小說好吸引，令我入迷，連電話都唔記得睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 teoi1 lei5 siu2 syut3 hou2 kap1 jan5 ling6 ngo5 jap6 mai4 lin4 din6 waa2 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 tai2

rows.note: Use this when the subject actively engrosses or captivates someone.

example.english: The director’s storytelling can engross me so much that I do not want to leave.
example.traditional: 呢個導演講故仔真係令我入迷，我一路聽到唔捨得走。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dou6 jin2 gong2 gu3 zai2 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 jap6 mai4 ngo5 jat1 lou6 teng1 dou3 m4 se2 dak1 zau2

rows.note: Use 投入 when being engrossed means becoming deeply involved in an activity or task.

example.english: When I write a report, I tend to engross myself in it and lose track of time.
example.traditional: 我一寫報告就好投入，成日做到唔知幾點。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 se2 bou3 gou3 zau6 hou2 tau4 jap6 sing4 jat6 zou6 dou3 m4 zi1 gei2 dim2
